questions.q: What does Power BI's lineage view show, and how is it kept current?
options: A manually drawn diagram that a governance team updates each quarter
An automatically generated diagram, built fresh for every workspace with no manual drawing required
A static image exported once when the workspace is created
A list of every user who has ever viewed a report
questions.explain: Lineage view is generated automatically for every workspace, which is exactly why it stays accurate instead of going stale like a manually maintained diagram would.

questions.q: What does isolating one artifact's chain in lineage view (via its double-arrow icon) actually do?
options: It permanently deletes everything else in the workspace
It highlights that artifact's upstream and downstream connections and dims everything unrelated
It emails every downstream owner automatically
It certifies the artifact
questions.explain: Selecting the double-arrow icon highlights just that artifact's chain and dims the rest of the canvas — useful for seeing structure, though it doesn't total up a number of impacted items on its own.

questions.q: What question does impact analysis answer that lineage view's diagram alone does not?
options: What color scheme the report uses
A counted, listed total of exactly who depends on an item, plus a way to notify them
How much the Power BI Premium capacity costs
Which DAX functions were used in the dataset's measures
questions.explain: Impact analysis gives a real count of impacted child items and workspaces, and adds a direct way to notify every affected contact — capabilities beyond what the lineage diagram alone provides.

questions.q: In the impact analysis pane shown in this lesson, how can impacted items be browsed?
options: Only alphabetically by item name
By item type or by workspace
Only by the date they were created
Impact analysis doesn't let you browse items at all
questions.explain: The impact analysis pane lets you switch between browsing impacted items by item type (reports, dashboards, etc.) or by the workspace they live in.

questions.q: What does the 'Notify contacts' action in impact analysis actually do?
options: It automatically rolls back any change made to the dataset
It sends an email notification to every contact across every impacted workspace, including ones you may not have access to yourself
It certifies every impacted downstream report
It deletes all impacted items to prevent them from breaking
questions.explain: Notify contacts emails every contact for every impacted workspace in one action — the dialog explicitly warns the email may reach many recipients across workspaces the sender can't access themselves.
